en: The front image shows a nighttime view of a brightly illuminated modernist hotel with the large, red neon sign 'METROPOL' on the roof. The building has many balconies and is surrounded by trees; its reflective lighting creates bright patterns on the ground. The reverse side contains multilingual printed text (Bulgarian, French, and German), handwritten numbers, and an official library stamp.
